title: Han dynasty
summary: The Western Han dynasty governed from 206 BCE to 9 CE. The period is one phase of Han rule, followed by an interruption before the Eastern Han.

citations.note: Supports the factual summary and chronology. Context includes explicitly interpretive comparisons; the date note identifies limits of precision.

claims.text: The Western Han dynasty governed from 206 BCE to 9 CE. The period is one phase of Han rule, followed by an interruption before the Eastern Han.
Western Han: 206 BCE–9 CE; Eastern Han: 25–220 CE. The intervening gap is not Han rule.
Separate phases prevent a dynasty from appearing as an uninterrupted political span. The conventional sequence organizes comparison without implying that all cultural practices changed with a ruler.
